data.title: 桃乐丝 · 温室花房的修剪
data.description: 伊甸园花房，她手持银剪修剪玫瑰，神情专注而温柔；剪掉枯枝的动作干净利落得近乎冷酷——她对待多余之物的方式向来如此。
data.action: 伊甸园花房，她手持银剪修剪玫瑰，神情专注而温柔
data.promptProse: In Eden's greenhouse, Dorothy examines a faded rose stem and makes a careful clean cut with small silver shears. Gloves and the gardening apron protect her cream blouse and long pink skirt, violet eyes focused rather than formally smiling. The medium portrait includes rose beds and overlapping greenhouse supports behind. Warm greenhouse light glints along the shears and pale petals, with leaf-filtered patches on pink hair and denser branch shadows deeper in the beds.
